summary: The commit removes the zero-divisor guard in safeDivide, so integer division by zero throws ArithmeticException instead of returning the -1 sentinel.

findings.explanation: Without the `b == 0` check, safeDivide(10, 0) evaluates `a / b` on integers and Java throws ArithmeticException: / by zero, so callers relying on the -1 sentinel now see the exception propagate.
